2) $TTE 

TotalEnergies signed Iran's South Pars gas deal in 2017, then walked away in 2018 when Trump tore up the nuclear deal. The relationship, the field, and the blueprint all still exist. A reopening gives the French major the clearest documented path of any oil name to return.
